title: Shape of an embedded configuration
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x,y$ be Boolean words, let $U$ be one of $k$ work tapes, let $c$ be a configuration on input $y$ with no work tapes and with rewind states, let $b$ be a Boolean tag, and let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $x$. Embedding the virtual-input configuration determined by $c$, $b$, and $p$ into $k$ tapes gives the configuration whose state is $c$'s state paired with $b$, whose input-head position is $p$, whose tape $U$ stores $y$, whose head on $U$ is at $c$'s input-head position minus one, whose other tapes are blank with heads at zero, and whose output is $c$'s output.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a work-tape index among $k$ tapes
$c$ is a zero-work-tape configuration on input $y$ with rewind states
$p$ is a valid input-head position for $x$
caveat: The configuration transformations are specialized constructions, so the prose describes their stated fields directly.
